name: Po Sah Inu towers
kicker: Three Cham towers on Ba Nai Hill
summary: Three Cham towers on Ba Nai Hill: walk the brick shrines, about 7 km from Phan Thiet. The main tower holds a Linga-Yoni altar. Admission is 7,000–15,000 VND. The gate runs from 7:00 to 17:00 or 18:00. Allow 120 minutes, or stay with no set limit.
getThere: About 7 km northeast of Phan Thiet center, on the road to the strip.
heroCaption: The main brick tower and a smaller shrine beside it
body: Walk the three brick towers on Ba Nai Hill in Phu Hai. These are 1,200-year-old Hoa Lai national monuments. The main tower holds a Linga-Yoni altar. A stone bull once stood in the middle tower and is gone.

The hill is about 7 km northeast of Phan Thiet center, on the road between the city and the Ham Tien strip. The address is Km9 Nguyễn Thông, Phường Phú Thuỷ, Lâm Đồng, and also Phường Phú Hài, Phan Thiết, Bình Thuận.

Allow 120 minutes, or stay with no set limit. Admission is 7,000–15,000 VND. Adults and children share that range. Katê was held here on the morning of 2 Oct 2024. An ordinary visit stays inside the posted hours.

figures.caption: The doorway and brick tiers of the main tower
figures.alt: Close view of the brick doorway and tiers of the Po Sah Inu main tower

gettingThere: The towers stand on Ba Nai Hill in Phu Hai, about 7 km northeast of Phan Thiet center. The stop is on the road between the city and the Ham Tien strip, clear of the fishing ward.

legs.heading: From Phan Thiet
legs.body: About 7 km northeast of the city center, on Ba Nai Hill. Km9 Nguyễn Thông, Phường Phú Thuỷ, Lâm Đồng, and Phường Phú Hài, Phan Thiết, Bình Thuận.

legs.heading: From the Ham Tien strip
legs.body: A stop on the way in from Phan Thiet, before the fishing ward. The hill is Phu Hai.
